kb001.title: 波音737 MAX系列
kb001.content: 波音737 MAX是波音737系列第四代产品，于2011年启动，2016年首飞。主要型号包括MAX 7、MAX 8、MAX 8-200、MAX 9和MAX 10。737 MAX采用CFM International LEAP-1B发动机，较前代737NG使用的CFM56-7B发动机燃油效率提升约14%。翼尖采用分裂式翼尖小翼（AT Winglet），最大起飞重量约82吨，航程约6,500公里。座舱为Sky Interior设计，配备波音Sky内饰LED环境照明，行李架空间增大50%。737 MAX是波音最畅销的窄体客机系列之一。

kb002.title: 数字电传操纵（Fly-by-Wire）系统
kb002.content: 数字电传操纵（Fly-by-Wire, FBW）系统是一种将飞行员指令通过电信号传输给飞行控制计算机，再由计算机通过作动器驱动控制面的飞行控制系统。空客A320（1988年投入运营）是世界上第一款采用全数字FBW的民用客机。FBW系统具有多重冗余设计（通常为四余度或三余度），并内置飞行包线保护（如失速保护、超速保护、坡度角限制等），大幅提升了飞行安全性。现代商用客机如空客A330/A350/A380和波音777/787均采用FBW系统，取代了传统的机械/液压联动操纵系统。

kb003.title: C919大型客机
kb003.content: C919是中国首款按照国际适航标准研制的干线客机。根据商飞（COMAC）官方资料，C919的最大起飞重量约77.3吨，最大商载约20.5吨，巡航速度0.78马赫（约930公里/小时），最大航程约5,555公里。采用CFM International LEAP-1C发动机，燃油效率较同类机型提升约12%。C919于2017年5月5日首飞，2022年12月9日交付全球首家用户中国东方航空，目前已获得超过1,000架订单。

kb004.title: 波音787 Dreamliner
kb004.content: 波音787 Dreamliner（梦想客机）是波音公司推出的超高效双发宽体客机，2011年投入运营。其最大技术突破在于大量应用先进复合材料：机身结构中复合材料按重量占比约50%，铝合金约20%，钛合金约15%，钢材约10%，其余为其他材料。787采用全电架构，取消了传统引气系统，改为电动压缩机提供座舱增压和除冰。得益于轻量化和高效发动机（GE GEnx或Rolls-Royce Trent 1000），787较同类机型燃油消耗降低约20%。主要型号包括787-8（242座，航程13,600公里）、787-9（290座，航程14,140公里）和787-10（330座，航程11,910公里）。

kb005.title: ARJ21新支线飞机
kb005.content: ARJ21（Advanced Regional Jet for the 21st Century）是中国自主研制的双发涡扇支线客机，2002年立项，2008年首飞，2015年交付首家用户成都航空。标准全经济舱布局90座，最大航程约3,700公里，巡航速度0.78马赫。ARJ21采用GE CF34-10A发动机，最大起飞重量约40.5吨。截至2024年，ARJ21已累计交付超过100架，航线覆盖国内及东南亚多条短程航线。

kb006.title: C929宽体远程客机
kb006.content: C929是中国商飞（COMAC）与俄罗斯联合航空制造集团（UAC）联合研制的双发宽体远程客机（原CR929项目），2017年启动。据中国商飞官网公开资料，C929采用双通道宽体布局，座位数约280座，航程达12,000公里（6,500海里）。采用新一代大涵道比涡扇发动机方案，复合材料用量占比超50%，机体结构寿命达到9万飞行小时/6万次起降，目标覆盖亚太远程航线。

kb007.title: ARJ21衍生型号
kb007.content: 据中国商飞官方公开资料，ARJ21已发展出公务机版（CBJ）、货运型（ARJ21-700F）、医疗救护型等多款衍生机型。CBJ公务机最大航程超5,500公里，客舱分为休息舱区、会议区和随行区；ARJ21-700F货运型最大商载约10吨，2023年获得CAAC型号合格证，填补国产喷气货机空白。

kb008.title: CCAR-25部结构适航要求
kb008.content: CCAR-25部《运输类飞机适航标准》是中国民航局（CAAC）颁布的核心适航规章，等效于美国FAR Part 25。CCAR-25.303条款要求飞机结构必须满足安全系数1.5的要求（即结构能承受1.5倍限制载荷而不破坏）。CCAR-25.571要求采用损伤容限设计——飞机在关键结构存在裂纹或损伤的情况下仍能承受极限载荷，保证飞行安全。

kb009.title: 中国民航适航审定体系
kb009.content: 根据CAAC民航局公开资料，中国民用航空适航审定体系以《中华人民共和国民用航空法》为核心，配套CCAR-21（民用航空产品和零部件合格审定规定）、CCAR-25（运输类飞机适航标准）、CCAR-33（航空发动机适航标准）等。适航审定分为型号合格审定（TC）、生产许可审定（PC）和单机适航审定（AC）三个阶段。2017年，中国民航局与EASA签署了《适航审定技术合作协议》。

kb010.title: 波音777X宽体科技旗舰
kb010.content: 波音777X是波音最新一代双发宽体远程客机，2013年启动，2020年首飞。据波音官网公开资料，777X采用GE9X发动机（全球最大商用涡扇发动机，风扇直径约3.4米，推力约105,000磅），翼展72米（带可折叠翼尖，收起后64.8米适配现有停机位）。机型包括777-8（约384座，航程16,170公里）和777-9（约426座，航程13,500公里），复合材料机翼是波音最大的单体复合材料结构。

kb011.title: 空客A350 XWB复合材料革命
kb011.content: 空客A350 XWB（Extra Wide Body）是空客新一代双发宽体客机，2013年首飞、2015年投入运营。据空客官网公开资料，A350机身结构中复合材料按重量占比约53%，是当前复合材料用量最高的商用客机之一。主要型号为A350-900（约315座，航程15,000公里）和A350-1000（约369座，航程16,100公里），采用罗尔斯·罗伊斯Trent XWB发动机。全机采用碳纤维复合材料机身蒙皮、机翼和尾翼，较铝合金结构减重约25%。

kb012.title: 航空发动机适航标准CCAR-33
kb012.content: 根据CAAC官方公开资料，CCAR-33部《航空发动机适航标准》规定了涡轮发动机（涡扇、涡喷、涡桨、涡轴）的适航审定要求。CCAR-33包含了持久试验（150小时连续运转）、包容性试验（风扇叶片脱落后机匣必须完整包容碎片）、鸟撞试验（中大型鸟吸入后发动机仍能安全停车）等严苛测试。还要求发动机必须通过结冰试验和吞水试验，确保极端天气下的安全性。

kb013.title: ICAO国际适航互认与公约体系
kb013.content: 据CAAC和EASA官方公开资料，国际民用航空组织（ICAO）《芝加哥公约》附件8（航空器适航性）是各国适航标准的基础框架。中国民航局与美国FAA于1995年签署双边适航协议（BAA），2015年升级。中欧适航合作方面，CAAC与EASA于2005年签署适航审定合作框架协议。根据《中华人民共和国民用航空法》第37条，具有外国国籍的航空器须经中国民航局认可其所在国颁发的适航证方可在我国飞行。

kb014.title: 中国商飞C919适航审定历程
kb014.content: 据中国商飞官网和CAAC公开资料，C919大型客机2010年11月获得CAAC型号合格证申请受理，2022年9月29日获得中国民航局颁发的型号合格证（TC），同年12月交付全球首家客户中国东方航空。审定过程中累计完成超过420个审定试飞科目、近1,700个飞行试验小时，验证了飞机在所有应急场景下的安全性。C919正在积极推进EASA适航互认审定。

kb015.title: FAA适航审定与持续适航要求
kb015.content: 据FAA官方公开资料，FAA Part 21规定型号合格证（TC）修改分为大改（需补充审定）和小改，Part 25附录H要求进行EWIS（电气线路互联系统）分析。持续适航方面，运营商必须按维修审查委员会（MRB）报告执行定期维修方案。FAA通过适航指令（AD）发布强制纠正措施。目前美国登记在册的运输类飞机超过7,000架（据FAA统计），是全球最大的民航机队。

kb020.title: 14 CFR Part 1 - Definitions (Part 1)
kb020.content:
Administrator means the Federal Aviation Administrator or any person to whom he has delegated his authority in the matter concerned.

Aerodynamic coefficients means non-dimensional coefficients for aerodynamic forces and moments.

Air carrier means a person who undertakes directly by lease, or other arrangement, to engage in air transportation.

Aircraft means a device that is used or intended to be used for flight in the air.

Aircraft engine means an engine that is used or intended to be used for propelling aircraft. It includes turbosuperchargers, appurtenances, and accessories necessary for its functioning, but does not include propellers.

Airframe means the fuselage, booms, nacelles, cowlings, fairings, airfoil surfaces (including rotors but excluding propellers and rotating airfoils of engines), and landing gear of an aircraft and their accessories and controls.

Airplane means an engine-driven fixed-wing aircraft heavier than air, that is supported in flight by the dynamic reaction of the air against its wings.

Airport means an area of land or water that is used or intended to be used for the landing and takeoff of aircraft, and includes its buildings and facilities, if any.

Air traffic means aircraft operating in the air or on an airport surface, exclusive of loading ramps and parking areas.

Air traffic clearance means an authorization by air traffic control, for the purpose of preventing collision between known aircraft, for an aircraft to proceed under specified traffic conditions within controlled airspace.

Air traffic control means a service operated by appropriate authority to promote the safe, orderly, and expeditious flow of air traffic.

Air transportation means interstate, overseas, or foreign air transportation or the transportation of mail by aircraft.

Alert Area. An alert area is established to inform pilots of a specific area wherein a high volume of pilot training or an unusual type of aeronautical activity is conducted.

kb021.title: 14 CFR Part 1 - Definitions (Part 2)
kb021.content:
Alternate airport means an airport at which an aircraft may land if a landing at the intended airport becomes inadvisable.

Altitude engine means a reciprocating aircraft engine having a rated takeoff power that is producible from sea level to an established higher altitude.

(1) Is propelled by a motor or motors having a combined total impulse of 889,600 Newton-seconds (200,000 pound-seconds) or less; and

(2) Cannot reach an altitude greater than 150 kilometers (93.2 statute miles) above the earth's surface.

Appliance means any instrument, mechanism, equipment, part, apparatus, appurtenance, or accessory, including communications equipment, that is used or intended to be used in operating or controlling an aircraft in flight, is installed in or attached to the aircraft, and is not part of an airframe, engine, or propeller.

Approved , unless used with reference to another person, means approved by the FAA or any person to whom the FAA has delegated its authority in the matter concerned, or approved under the provisions of a bilateral agreement between the United States and a foreign country or jurisdiction.

Armed Forces means the Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, and Coast Guard, including their regular and reserve components and members serving without component status.

Autorotation means a rotorcraft or powered-lift flight condition in which the lifting rotor is driven entirely by action of the air when the rotorcraft or powered-lift is in motion.

Auxiliary rotor means a rotor that serves either to counteract the effect of the main rotor torque on a rotorcraft or to maneuver the rotorcraft about one or more of its three principal axes.

Balloon means a lighter-than-air aircraft that is not engine driven, and that sustains flight through the use of either gas buoyancy or an airborne heater.

Brake horsepower means the power delivered at the propeller shaft (main drive or main output) of an aircraft engine.

kb022.title: 14 CFR Part 1 - Definitions (Part 3)
kb022.content:
Calibrated airspeed means the indicated airspeed of an aircraft, corrected for position and instrument error. Calibrated airspeed is equal to true airspeed in standard atmosphere at sea level.

Canard means the forward wing of a canard configuration and may be a fixed, movable, or variable geometry surface, with or without control surfaces.

Canard configuration means a configuration in which the span of the forward wing is substantially less than that of the main wing.

(1) As used with respect to the certification, ratings, privileges, and limitations of airmen, means a broad classification of aircraft. Examples include: airplane; rotorcraft; glider; and lighter-than-air; and

(2) As used with respect to the certification of aircraft, means a grouping of aircraft based upon intended use or operating limitations. Examples include: transport, normal, utility, acrobatic, limited, restricted, and provisional.

Authority: 42 U.S.C. 7572; 49 U.S.C. 106(f), 40105, 40113, 44701-44702, 44704, 44707, 44709, 44711, 44713, 44715, 45303.

Editorial Notes: 1. For miscellaneous amendments to cross references in this 21 see Amdt. 21-10, 31 FR 9211, July 6, 1966.

Special Federal Aviation Regulation No. 88—Fuel Tank System Fault Tolerance Evaluation Requirements

1. Applicability. This SFAR applies to the holders of type certificates, and supplemental type certificates that may affect the airplane fuel tank system, for turbine-powered transport category airplanes, provided the type certificate was issued after January 1, 1958, and the airplane has either a maximum type certificated passenger capacity of 30 or more, or a maximum type certificated payload capacity of 7,500 pounds or more. This SFAR also applies to applicants for type certificates, amendments to a type certificate, and supplemental type certificates affecting the fuel tank systems for those airplanes identified above, if the application was filed before June 6, 2001, the effective date of this SFAR, and the certificate was not issued before June 6, 2001.

2. Compliance: Each type certificate holder, and each supplemental type certificate holder of a modification affecting the airplane fuel tank system, must accomplish the following within the compliance times specified in paragraph (e) of this section:

(a) Conduct a safety review of the airplane fuel tank system to determine that the design meets the requirements of §§ 25.901 and 25.981(a) and (b) of this chapter. If the current design does not meet these requirements, develop all design changes to the fuel tank system that are necessary to meet these requirements. The responsible Aircraft Certification Service office for the affected airplane may grant an extension of the 18-month compliance time for development of design changes if:

kb024.content:
(3) Additional time can be justified, based on the holder's demonstrated aggressiveness in performing the safety review, the complexity of the necessary design changes, the availability of interim actions to provide an acceptable level of safety, and the resulting level of safety.

(b) Develop all maintenance and inspection instructions necessary to maintain the design features required to preclude the existence or development of an ignition source within the fuel tank system of the airplane.

(c) Submit a report for approval to the responsible Aircraft Certification Service office for the affected airplane, that:

(1) Provides substantiation that the airplane fuel tank system design, including all necessary design changes, meets the requirements of §§ 25.901 and 25.981(a) and (b) of this chapter; and

(2) Contains all maintenance and inspection instructions necessary to maintain the design features required to preclude the existence or development of an ignition source within the fuel tank system throughout the operational life of the airplane.

(d) The responsible Aircraft Certification Service office for the affected airplane, may approve a report submitted in accordance with paragraph 2(c) if it determines that any provisions of this SFAR not complied with are compensated for by factors that provide an equivalent level of safety.

(e) Each type certificate holder must comply no later than December 6, 2002, or within 18 months after the issuance of a type certificate for which application was filed before June 6, 2001, whichever is later; and each supplemental type certificate holder of a modification affecting the airplane fuel tank system must comply no later than June 6, 2003, or within 18 months after the issuance of a supplemental type certificate for which application was filed before June 6, 2001, whichever is later.

Authority: 49 U.S.C. 106(f), 106(g), 40113, 44701, 44702 and 44704; Pub. L. 115-254, 132 Stat 3281 (49 U.S.C. 44903 note).

1. Applicability. Contrary provisions of the Civil Air Regulations regarding certification notwithstanding,

this regulation shall provide the basis for approval by the Administrator of modifications of individual Douglas DC-3 and Lockheed L-18 airplanes subsequent to the effective date of this regulation.

1 It is not intended to waive compliance with such airworthiness requirements as are included in the operating parts of the Civil Air Regulations for specific types of operation.

2. General modifications. Except as modified in sections 3 and 4 of this regulation, an applicant for approval of modifications to a DC-3 or L-18 airplane which result in changes in design or in changes to approved limitations shall show that the modifications were accomplished in accordance with the rules of either Part 4a or Part 4b in effect on September 1, 1953, which are applicable to the modification being made: Provided, That an applicant may elect to accomplish a modification in accordance with the rules of Part 4b in effect on the date of application for the modification in lieu of Part 4a or Part 4b as in effect on September 1, 1953: And provided further, That each specific modification must be accomplished in accordance with all of the provisions contained in the elected rules relating to the particular modification.

3. Specific conditions for approval. An applicant for any approval of the following specific changes shall comply with section 2 of this regulation as modified by the applicable provisions of this section.

(a) Increase in take-off power limitation—1,200 to 1,350 horsepower. The engine take-off power limitation for the airplane may be increased to more than 1,200 horsepower but not to more than 1,350 horsepower per engine if the increase in power does not adversely affect the flight characteristics of the airplane.

kb027.title: 14 CFR Part 25 - Airworthiness Standards: Transport Category (Part 2)
kb027.content:
(b) Increase in take-off power limitation to more than 1,350 horsepower. The engine take-off power limitation for the airplane may be increased to more than 1,350 horsepower per engine if compliance is shown with the flight characteristics and ground handling requirements of Part 4b.

(c) Installation of engines of not more than 1,830 cubic inches displacement and not having a certificated take-off rating of more than 1,350 horsepower. Engines of not more than 1,830 cubic inches displacement and not having a certificated take-off rating of more than 1,350 horsepower which necessitate a major modification of redesign of the engine installation may be installed, if the engine fire prevention and fire protection are equivalent to that on the prior engine installation.

(d) Installation of engines of more than 1,830 cubic inches displacement or having certificated take-off rating of more than 1,350 horsepower. Engines of more than 1,830 cubic inches displacement or having certificated take-off rating of more than 1,350 horsepower may be installed if compliance is shown with the engine installation requirements of Part 4b: Provided, That where literal compliance with the engine installation requirements of Part 4b is extremely difficult to accomplish and would not contribute materially to the objective sought, and the Administrator finds that the experience with the DC-3 or L-18 airplanes justifies it, he is authorized to accept such measures of compliance as he finds will effectively accomplish the basic objective.

4. Establishment of new maximum certificated weights. An applicant for approval of new maximum certificated weights shall apply for an amendment of the airworthiness certificate of the airplane and shall show that the weights sought have been established, and the appropriate manual material obtained, as provided in this section.

Transport category performance requirements result in the establishment of maximum certificated weights for various altitudes.

(b) Each person who applies under part 21 for such a certificate or change must show compliance with the applicable requirements of this part and the applicable requirements of part 34 of this chapter.

Each applicant must show that the aircraft engine concerned meets the applicable requirements of this part.

The applicant must prepare Instructions for Continued Airworthiness in accordance with appendix A to this part that are acceptable to the Administrator. The instructions may be incomplete at type certification if a program exists to ensure their completion prior to delivery of the first aircraft with the engine installed, or upon issuance of a standard certificate of airworthiness for the aircraft with the engine installed, whichever occurs later.

Each applicant must prepare and make available to the Administrator prior to the issuance of the type certificate, and to the owner at the time of delivery of the engine, approved instructions for installing and operating the engine. The instructions must include at least the following:

(a) Installation instructions. (1) The location of engine mounting attachments, the method of attaching the engine to the aircraft, and the maximum allowable load for the mounting attachments and related structure.

(2) The location and description of engine connections to be attached to accessories, pipes, wires, cables, ducts, and cowling.

(4) A definition of the physical and functional interfaces with the aircraft and aircraft equipment, including the propeller when applicable.

(b) Operation instructions. (1) The operating limitations established by the Administrator.

(2) The power or thrust ratings and procedures for correcting for nonstandard atmosphere.

(4) For rotorcraft engines having one or more OEI ratings, applicants must provide data on engine performance characteristics and variability to enable the aircraft manufacturer to establish aircraft power assurance procedures.

(5) A description of the primary and all alternate modes, and any back-up system, together with any associated limitations, of the engine control system and its interface with the aircraft systems, including the propeller when applicable.

(c) Safety analysis assumptions. Special Federal Aviation Regulation No. 73—Robinson Helicopter Company, Robinson R-22/R-44 Special Training and Experience Requirements

1. Applicability. Under the procedures prescribed in this section, this Special Federal Aviation Regulation (SFAR) applies to all persons who seek to manipulate the controls, act as pilot in command, provide ground training or flight training, or conduct a flight review in a Robinson model R-22 or R-44 helicopter. The requirements stated in this SFAR are in addition to the current requirements of this part.

(1) Except as provided in paragraph 2(a)(2) of this SFAR, no person may manipulate the controls of a Robinson model R-22 or R-44 helicopter-for the purpose of flight unless the ground training specified in paragraph 2(a)(3) of this SFAR is completed and the person's logbook has been endorsed by a flight instructor authorized under paragraph 2(b)(5)(iv) of this SFAR.

(2) A person who holds a rotorcraft category and helicopter class rating on that person's pilot certificate and meets the experience requirements of paragraph 2(b)(1) or paragraph 2(b)(2) of this SFAR may not manipulate the controls of a Robinson model R-22 or R-44 helicopter for the purpose of flight unless the ground training specified in paragraph 2(a)(3) of this SFAR is completed and the person's logbook has been endorsed by a flight instructor authorized under paragraph 2(b)(5)(iv) of this SFAR.

(3) Ground training must be conducted by a flight instructor who has been authorized under paragraph 2(b)(5)(iv) of this SFAR and consists of the following general subject areas:

(4) The general subject areas identified in paragraph 2(a)(3) of this SFAR are intended to cover both Robinson model R-22 and R-44 helicopters.

questions.question: 波音737 MAX系列采用的发动机型号是什么？
questions.explanation: 737 MAX采用CFM International LEAP-1B发动机，燃油效率较前代提升14%。GE90-115B装备波音777，Trent 1000装备787，PW4000装备部分767和747。

questions.question: 世界上第一款采用数字电传操纵（Fly-by-wire）的民用客机是？
questions.explanation: 空客A320是世界上第一款采用数字电传操纵（Fly-by-wire）的民用客机，1988年首次投入运营。

questions.question: C919大型客机的最大起飞重量约为多少？
questions.explanation: 根据商飞官方资料，C919的最大起飞重量约77.3吨，巡航速度0.78马赫。

questions.question: 波音787机身结构中，复合材料按重量占比约为多少？
questions.explanation: 根据波音官方资料，787机身结构中复合材料按重量占比约50%，铝合金约20%，钛合金约15%，钢材约10%。

questions.question: ARJ21新支线飞机最大航程约为多少公里？
questions.explanation: ARJ21标准全经济舱布局最大航程约3,700公里。C919最大航程约5,555公里。

questions.question: C929宽体客机的目标航程是多少？
questions.explanation: 根据中国商飞官网公开资料，C929航程达12,000公里（6,500海里），采用双通道宽体布局约280座。

questions.question: ARJ21-700F货运型的最大商载约为多少？
questions.explanation: ARJ21-700F货运型最大商载约10吨，2023年获得CAAC型号合格证。

questions.question: CCAR-25.303规定飞机结构安全系数为多少倍限制载荷？
questions.explanation: CCAR-25.303条款要求飞机结构必须满足安全系数1.5的要求，即结构能承受1.5倍限制载荷而不破坏，与FAR Part 25.303等效。

questions.question: 中国民航局适航审定的三个阶段不包括哪个？
questions.explanation: 适航审定分为TC、PC、AC三个阶段，运营合格审定不属于适航审定范围。

questions.question: 波音777X采用GE9X发动机的风扇直径约为多少？
questions.explanation: 据波音官网，GE9X风扇直径约3.4米（134英寸），推力约105,000磅，是全球最大商用涡扇发动机。

questions.question: 空客A350 XWB机身复合材料按重量占比约为多少？
questions.explanation: 据空客官网公开资料，A350机身复合材料按重量占比约53%，是目前复合材料用量最高的商用客机之一。

questions.question: CCAR-33部规定的发动机持久试验要求连续运转多少小时？
questions.explanation: 根据CAAC官方资料，CCAR-33要求发动机完成150小时连续运转的持久试验，验证其耐久性和可靠性。

questions.question: ICAO航空器适航性的基础公约依据是？
questions.explanation: ICAO《芝加哥公约》附件8（航空器适航性）是各国适航标准的基础框架，各缔约国据此制定本国适航法规。

questions.question: C919大型客机获得CAAC型号合格证（TC）的时间是？
questions.explanation: 据中国商飞官网和CAAC公开资料，C919于2022年9月29日获得中国民航局颁发的型号合格证（TC）。

questions.question: FAA发布强制纠正措施的文件被称为？
questions.explanation: FAA通过适航指令（AD）发布强制纠正措施，具有法律约束力，运营商必须执行。SB（服务通告）由制造商发布，非强制。

questions.question: GE90发动机的涵道比约为多少？
questions.explanation: GE90发动机的涵道比约为9:1，Leap-1C约为11:1。涵道比越大，燃油效率越高，噪声越低。

questions.question: GE90-115B的认证推力是多少？
questions.explanation: GE90-115B认证推力为115,300磅（513kN），是目前推力最大的商用航空发动机。

questions.question: LEAP发动机采用了哪种先进的风扇叶片制造工艺？
options: 三维编织碳纤维复合材料RTM工艺
questions.explanation: LEAP发动机采用三维编织碳纤维复合材料风扇叶片（RTM工艺：Resin Transfer Molding）。

questions.question: Jet A-1航空燃油的冰点是多少？
questions.explanation: Jet A-1的冰点为-47°C，适合高纬度远程飞行；Jet A冰点为-40°C，主要用于美国国内航线。

questions.question: 波音737NG系列通常安装哪个型号的APU？
questions.explanation: 波音737NG系列通常安装霍尼韦尔（Honeywell）131-9(B)型APU，最大输出功率约90kVA。

questions.question: 国际民用航空组织（ICAO）是根据哪个公约成立的？
questions.explanation: ICAO根据《国际民用航空公约》（芝加哥公约，1944年签署）成立，截至2024年有193个成员国。

questions.question: 中国民用航空规章中，规定运输类飞机适航标准的是哪一部？
questions.explanation: CCAR-25是运输类飞机适航标准，与FAR Part 25等效。CCAR-21是产品合格审定，CCAR-33是发动机适航标准，CCAR-91是一般运行规则。

questions.question: FAR Part 25 §25.303规定的结构安全系数通常为多少倍限制载荷？
questions.explanation: FAR Part 25 §25.303规定了安全系数要求，通常为1.5倍限制载荷。

questions.question: CORSIA（国际航空碳抵消与减排计划）于哪一年进入试行阶段？
questions.explanation: CORSIA于2017年通过，2021年进入试行阶段，要求航空公司抵消超过2019年排放基准的排放增长。

questions.question: FAA Part 107规定商业无人机飞行高度不得超过多少？
questions.explanation: FAA Part 107规定商业无人机飞行须在视距内（VLOS）、高度不超过400英尺、昼间作业。

questions.question: 民航客机座舱失压时，旅客氧气面罩的化学发生器设计供氧时长约为多少？
questions.explanation: 化学发生器设计供氧12-15分钟，正好匹配客机从巡航高度紧急下降到4000米以下安全高度所需的时间。

questions.question: 关于高空缺氧的"有效意识时间"（TUC），下列说法正确的是？
options: 海拔越高，有效意识时间越长
15,000米高空有效意识时间约3-5分钟

questions.question: 飞行员承受正过载（+Gz）时，视野变灰（灰视）约出现在多少G？
questions.explanation: 约+4G出现灰视（Grey-out），约+5G黑视（Black-out），+6G以上发生G-LOC（过载引起的意识丧失）。

questions.question: F-16战斗机采用哪种抗荷设计来提高正过载耐受能力？
questions.explanation: F-16的30度倾斜座椅+抬腿设计缩短了心脏与大脑的垂直距离，耐受能力提高至9G。

questions.question: 潜水后多长时间内飞行会显著增加减压病（DCS）风险？
questions.explanation: 潜水使体内组织氮气饱和，潜水后12-24小时内飞行会大幅增加DCS风险。

questions.question: 按照中国CCAR-121规定，飞行员血液酒精含量达到多少必须立即停飞？
questions.explanation: CCAR-121规定血液酒精含量>0.02%为饮酒、>0.04%必须立即停飞；饮用含酒精饮料后8小时内不得执勤。

questions.question: ICAO/FAA将全动飞行模拟机（FFS）分为A-D四级，其中最高等级是？
questions.explanation: D级为最高级：昼夜全气候模拟+操纵载荷感+颠簸模拟，可用于全部机型训练和检查。

questions.question: FFS的C级模拟机相比B级增加的标志性能力是？
options: 可用于零飞行时间训练（ZFTT）
可执行发动机性能测试
questions.explanation: C级：六自由度液压平台+宽视景投影+特定机场数据库，可用于零飞行时间训练（ZFTT）。

questions.question: 模拟机运动平台通过"洗出算法"（Washout Algorithm）实现的是？
options: 用有限行程模拟无限飞行包线，欺骗前庭系统
questions.explanation: 洗出算法在模拟起始加速度后1-2秒缓慢回中（低于前庭感知阈值），用有限行程模拟无限包线。

questions.question: 模拟器眩晕（Simulator Sickness）的主要成因是？
options: 视觉高保真运动感与平台有限物理运动感不匹配
questions.explanation: 前庭系统收到视觉与物理运动冲突信号导致恶心、出汗和定向障碍，约10%-20%学员初期出现，3-5次后适应。

questions.question: LOFT（航线导向飞行训练）的评估重点是？
options: 机组的沟通、领导力和工作负荷分配
是否出现标准答案流程
questions.explanation: LOFT注入动态故障/异常，没有标准答案，重点评估机组协同、决策和CRM能力。

questions.question: ICAO的MPL（多人制机组驾驶员执照）训练特点是什么？
options: 从零到副驾驶约240小时，其中约190小时在FFS完成
questions.explanation: MPL以航线能力为导向，从零训练到副驾驶约240小时，大部分（约190小时）在FFS完成。

questions.question: 航空摄影测量中，航向重叠率一般要求为？
questions.explanation: 航向重叠60%-80%、旁向重叠30%-40%，确保形成立体像对用于三维地形重建。

questions.question: 航空摄影中的POS系统的主要作用是？
options: 记录每张照片曝光瞬间的位置姿态，用于外方位元素解算
questions.explanation: POS系统由高精度GNSS+IMU组成，记录曝光瞬间位置姿态用于外方位元素解算。

questions.question: 合成孔径雷达（SAR）相较于光学遥感的关键优势是？
options: 全天候：微波穿透云层雨雾，夜间也能成像
questions.explanation: SAR是主动微波遥感，穿透云层雨雾且夜间可成像；光学遥感做不到。

questions.question: InSAR（干涉SAR）技术主要用于测量？
questions.explanation: InSAR通过两次过境的相位差测量毫米级地表形变，用于地震、火山、地面沉降监测。

questions.question: 机载LiDAR区别于光学遥感的一大优势是？
options: 激光部分穿透植被冠层获取地面高程（DTM）
questions.explanation: LiDAR激光可部分穿透植被冠层获取"裸地"高程模型，这是光学遥感无法实现的。

questions.question: 航空磁法测量中，磁力计通常安装在飞机的什么位置？
questions.explanation: 磁力计安装在尾梁尾锥或吊舱，以远离机身钢铁干扰，灵敏度可达0.001nT。

questions.question: 飞机的副翼（Aileron）主要控制哪个方向的运动？
questions.explanation: 副翼位于机翼后缘外侧，用于滚转控制；升降舵控制俯仰，方向舵控制偏航。

questions.question: 波音777主起落架的机轮配置是？
questions.explanation: 波音777主起落架每侧6个机轮（共12轮），以分散重量、保护跑道道面。

questions.question: 1903年莱特兄弟"飞行者一号"首次动力飞行的数据是？
questions.explanation: 1903年12月17日首次飞行由Orville驾驶，持续12秒、距离约36.5米；当天共4次，最后一次59秒约260米。

questions.question: 协和号超音速客机的巡航速度约为？
questions.explanation: 协和号巡航速度Mach 2.04（约2180km/h），伦敦到纽约仅约3.5小时，2003年退役，共生产20架。

questions.question: 现代空气动力学认为飞机升力的完整解释包含？
options: 仅伯努利原理的压力差
压力分布差与气流偏转反作用力（牛顿第三定律）的共同作用
发动机推力的垂直分量
questions.explanation: 升力同时由上下表面压力差（伯努利）和翼型向下偏转气流的反作用力产生，两种解释共同作用。

questions.question: 飞机失速（Stall）的本质是？
options: 迎角超过临界值后机翼上表面气流分离、升力急剧下降
questions.explanation: 失速是气动现象而非发动机故障，典型临界迎角约15-16度；FAA要求运输类飞机安装失速保护系统。

questions.question: TCAS II发出Resolution Advisory（RA）时，飞行员应？
options: 优先执行RA垂直避让指令，再协调管制
questions.explanation: TCAS II的RA是垂直避让指令，飞行员必须优先执行RA而非管制指令（2002年乌伯林根空难后强制）。

questions.question: ADS-B Out的广播频率大约是？
questions.explanation: ADS-B通过GPS确定位置后通常每秒广播一次位置、高度、速度、呼号数据包。

questions.question: 波音787机身结构中复合材料按重量占比约为？
questions.explanation: 波音787复合材料占比约50%，空客A350约53%，CFRP比强度远超铝合金。

questions.question: Ti-6Al-4V（TC4）钛合金在航空中主要用于？
options: 发动机风扇叶片、起落架部件和高温区结构
questions.explanation: TC4是最常用航空钛合金，用于发动机风扇叶片、起落架部件和机身高温区；F-22钛合金占比41%。

questions.question: ICAO将空域按等级划分为几个等级？
questions.explanation: ICAO将空域分为A至G七个等级，A级仅IFR且需ATC许可，G级为非管制空域。

questions.question: 仪表着陆系统（ILS）的三大组成是？
options: 航向道、下滑道、指点信标
questions.explanation: ILS由航向道（Localizer）、下滑道（Glideslope）和指点信标（Marker Beacon）组成，支持CAT I-III进近。

questions.question: 瑞士奶酪模型（Swiss Cheese Model）的提出者是？
questions.explanation: 由英国心理学家James Reason于1990年提出，强调组织性事故：所有防御层漏洞对齐时事故才发生。

questions.question: FAR 33.77规定的发动机鸟击认证标准是？
options: 发动机能吞2只1kg鸟不停车
发动机能吞4只1.85kg鸟不停车
发动机能吞8只0.5kg鸟不停车
发动机能吞1只3kg鸟不停车
questions.explanation: FAR 33.77要求发动机吞入4只1.85kg鸟类后仍不停车；2009年全美航空1549事件为典型鸟击双发失效案例。

questions.question: F-22猛禽在不开启加力的情况下可维持的超音速巡航速度约为？
questions.explanation: F-22采用F119-PW-100发动机，推重比超9:1，超音速巡航约Mach 1.5，RCS约0.0001平方米。

questions.question: 中国歼-20（威龙）战斗机首次试飞的时间是？
questions.explanation: 歼-20由成飞研制，2011年1月首飞、2017年服役，鸭翼+三角翼布局，使中国成为第二个列装五代机的国家。

questions.question: 1985年达美航空191航班事故后，FAA强制安装了什么设备？
options: 低空风切变告警系统（LLWAS）和终端多普勒气象雷达（TDWR）
questions.explanation: 该机在达拉斯遭遇微下击暴流坠毁，此后FAA强制安装LLWAS和TDWR。

questions.question: FAA建议飞行员在雷暴回波外多少距离绕行？
questions.explanation: FAA建议在雷暴回波20海里（约37km）外绕行，雷暴含闪电、冰雹、颠簸、下击暴流等危险。

questions.question: 俄罗斯卡莫夫共轴双旋翼直升机（如Ka-52）的特点是？
options: 双旋翼反向旋转自动抵消扭矩，不需尾桨
questions.explanation: 共轴双旋翼反向旋转自动抵消反扭矩，因此不需要尾桨；Fenestron涵道尾桨、NOTAR无尾桨为其他方案。

questions.question: 直升机自旋降落（Autorotation）的原理是？
options: 利用发动机剩余动力滑翔
利用下降气流驱动旋翼旋转储存动能，近地拉平将其转化为升力减速着陆
依靠尾桨产生推力减速
questions.explanation: 发动机失效后，下降气流驱动旋翼自由旋转将重力势能转化为旋翼动能，接地前(约30-50米)拉大桨距释放能量实现软着陆。

questions.question: 齐奥尔科夫斯基火箭方程的正确形式是？
questions.explanation: Δv = ve × ln(m0/m1)，其中ve为排气速度，m0/m1为质量比；比冲决定ve，多级火箭是实现轨道速度的关键。

questions.question: 猎鹰9号一级火箭目前已实现的复用次数约为？
questions.explanation: 猎鹰9一级已实现超过20次复用，每公斤LEO发射成本从约60,000美元降至约2,700美元。

questions.question: 磁方位角为095°的跑道，其跑道编号应为？
questions.explanation: 跑道编号取磁方位角前两位数（去掉个位），095°编号为09；平行跑道加L/R/C区分。

questions.question: PAPI指示器的"两红两白"表示什么？
questions.explanation: 全白偏高、两红两白正确、全红偏低；PAPI通过红白灯组合引导飞行员保持下滑道。

questions.question: 航空公司成本中通常占比最大的单项变动成本是？
questions.explanation: 燃油通常占总成本25%-35%，随油价大幅波动，是航司最大单项变动成本；盈亏平衡载客率一般需70%-85%。

questions.question: 航空收益管理中，'超售'（Overbooking）的主要目的是？
options: 弥补旅客No-Show（购票未乘机）造成的座位浪费
questions.explanation: 超售根据No-Show概率出售多于座位的票，弥补未登机损失，是收益管理核心算法之一，通常可提升收入3%-8%。

questions.question: 枢纽-轮辐（Hub-and-Spoke）航线网络模式的主要优点是？
options: 以较少航班覆盖更多城市对，形成密度经济
questions.explanation: 枢纽模式以少数枢纽集中转机，提高飞机与机组利用率、创造密度经济；代价是增加中转时间与枢纽容量瓶颈。

questions.question: 中国国际航空、汉莎航空、美联航属于哪个航空联盟？
questions.explanation: 星空联盟（1997年）成员含国航、汉莎、美联航；天合联盟含东航南航法荷航；寰宇一家含国泰英航美航。

questions.question: 中国首家低成本航空（LCC）是？
questions.explanation: 春秋航空2005年成立，是中国首家LCC，采用单一机型（波音737）、高密度布局、二线机场与辅助收入模式。

questions.question: 疫情期间航空货运运力大幅紧张的直接原因是？
options: 客机腹舱运力大幅萎缩
questions.explanation: 疫情导致大量客机停飞，客机腹舱运力（Belly Cargo）大幅萎缩，全货机运力与租金暴涨，凸显货运独立价值。

questions.question: 大型枢纽机场非航收入（商业租赁、餐饮零售等）通常占比可达？
questions.explanation: 大型枢纽机场非航收入占比常超50%，是机场盈利核心；国际旅客占比越高，非航收入占比越高。

questions.question: 航空公司对冲油价风险的手段中，属于金融对冲的是？
options: 购买原油期权/远期合约锁定价格
questions.explanation: 航油套期保值通过原油期权/远期合约锁定未来油价；燃油附加费、节油运营属于其他应对手段。

questions.question: 多旋翼无人机相比固定翼无人机的主要优势是？
options: 悬停性能好、适合起降受限场地
questions.explanation: 多旋翼依靠转速差控制姿态，悬停好、可垂直起降；固定翼航时长、速度快，但起降需跑道或弹射/伞降。

questions.question: 无人机飞控系统（FC）中，用于解算姿态与位置的核心传感器组合是？
options: IMU（陀螺仪+加速度计）与GPS/视觉融合
questions.explanation: 飞控通过IMU、气压计、磁力计、GPS/北斗等融合（如卡尔曼滤波）解算姿态位置，实现RTK厘米级定位与自动飞行。

questions.question: 农业植保无人机相比传统拖拉机喷药的主要优势不包括？
options: 适合丘陵果园等复杂地形
可以完全替代人工田间管理
questions.explanation: 植保无人机优势：不碾压、效率高、节药30%-50%、适合丘陵；但不能完全替代人工田间管理。

questions.question: 无人机医疗配送（如Zipline在非洲）商业化最快的场景是？
options: 血液、疫苗等紧急医疗品配送
questions.explanation: 医疗配送因高时效价值成为最快商业化场景（Zipline在卢旺达/加纳运营全国血袋配送）；餐饮外卖也在深圳等试点。

questions.question: 中国《无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例》于何时施行？
questions.explanation: 条例2024年1月1日起施行，确立分类管理（微型/轻型/小型/中型/大型）、实名登记、适航审定与飞行活动管理框架。

questions.question: 消费级航拍无人机主要由哪家公司率先普及？
questions.explanation: 大疆创新2013年以Phantom系列普及消费航拍，集成4K/8K相机、云台、视觉避障与AI功能，是全球消费无人机龙头。

questions.question: FPV无人机竞速的显著特点是？
options: 速度可达200km/h以上，飞行时间仅数分钟
questions.explanation: 竞速无人机轻量化碳纤维机架、大功率电机，时速200km/h以上，飞行仅2-5分钟，戴FPV护目镜操控。

questions.question: 无人机反制中'软杀伤'手段不包括？
questions.explanation: 软杀伤为干扰/欺骗/接管；激光打击属于硬摧毁；探测包括雷达、光电与频谱侦测。

questions.question: 世界上首款投入作战的喷气式战斗机是？
questions.explanation: 德国Me 262（1944年）是世界首款投入作战的喷气式战斗机；P-51为活塞螺旋桨战机。

questions.question: 2002年中国民航'集团化重组'中，合并西北航与云南航的是？
questions.explanation: 东航合并西北航、云南航；南航合并北方航、新疆航；国航合并西南航，三大航空集团格局形成。

questions.question: 首款量产直升机（Sikorsky R-4）投入使用的时间是？
questions.explanation: 1940年VS-300首飞，1942年R-4量产，确立单旋翼带尾桨经典布局。

questions.question: 机上急救（IMED）处置流程中，机组判断是否备降主要依据？
options: 医疗咨询与患者状况评估
questions.explanation: 机组联系医疗咨询（如MedAire）并基于患者状况评估决定备降；机上配备急救箱、AED与氧气。

questions.question: 美国航空安全自愿报告系统（ASRS）由哪个机构运营？
questions.explanation: NASA自1976年运营ASRS，接受飞行员/管制员/机务匿名上报，自我披露免责，是安全数据黄金渠道。

questions.question: FOQA（QAR分析）中'重着陆'事件通常以什么为判定阈值？
questions.explanation: 重着陆通常以垂直加速度>1.5G判定；QAR事件还包括进近不稳定、超速、GPWS告警等。

questions.question: 美国战略轰炸机中，采用隐身飞翼布局的是？
questions.explanation: B-2幽灵采用无垂尾无平尾的飞翼布局，隐身突防，仅生产21架；B-52为八发亚音速，B-1B可变后掠翼。

questions.question: 中国辽宁舰/山东舰采用哪种舰载机起飞方式？
questions.explanation: 中国航母采用滑跃起飞+阻拦索降落（歼-15）；美国核动力航母采用弹射（含EMALS电磁弹射）。

questions.question: 空警-500预警机采用的数据阵雷达特点是？
options: 新型数字阵雷达，信息处理能力强
questions.explanation: 空警-500以运-9为平台、数字阵雷达，信息处理能力强；空警-2000为三面阵；E-3为旋转雷达罩。

questions.question: 中国民航运输机场按功能规模分类中，不包括？
questions.explanation: 中国民用运输机场分类：国际枢纽、区域枢纽、干线、支线机场；'货运枢纽'不在官方四分类中。

questions.question: 跑道道面强度指标PCN与飞机ACN的关系是？
questions.explanation: 当飞机ACN≤跑道PCN时可无限制运行；ACN>PCN需减载或限制运行。

questions.question: 中国大多数机场的航油供应由哪家企业负责？
options: 中航油（中国航空油料集团）
questions.explanation: 中国机场加油多由中国航空油料集团（中航油）专营，保障Jet A-1煤油供应与加油质量控制。

questions.question: 根据升力公式，空速翻倍时升力约为原来的几倍？
questions.explanation: 升力与空速平方成正比（L=½ρV²SCL），速度翻倍升力变4倍，这就是起飞需要足够速度的原因。

questions.question: 翼尖小翼主要用于减小哪种阻力？
questions.explanation: 翼尖小翼削弱翼尖涡流、减小诱导阻力；巡航段诱导阻力占总阻力25%-30%，小翼收益明显。

questions.question: 钛合金相比钢的主要优势是？
questions.explanation: 钛合金密度约4.5g/cm³（钢的57%）、比强度高、耐温耐蚀，用于发动机风扇叶片、起落架等。

questions.question: 高涵道比涡扇发动机（涵道比8:1以上）的主要优势是？
questions.explanation: 高涵道比（如LEAP、PW1100G）外涵流量占比高，推进效率高、油耗低、噪声低，是现代干线客机主流。

questions.question: 飞行模拟机认证等级鉴定所依据的飞行数据包来自？
options: 飞机厂商官方试飞数据包（FDP）
questions.explanation: 模拟机必须使用飞机厂商官方数据包并经数据校验（与真机比对），才能获得等级鉴定与适航认证。
